set.t: Silver half-dollars respond well to a detector. Accomplices may have taken the bulk. The capture pasture (grove by the farmstead, or the woodlot just east across the road, NW corner of Dover Twp) is the west end of the route; the silver was thought planted somewhere between there and St. Charles. Private land: permission.
set.pl: St. Charles-Dover-Eyota route along the Great Western line; capture farm in sec 18 T106N R11W (Dover Twp, on the Eyota line), farmstead and grove about 43.9844,-92.1800 (1914 Olmsted atlas)
pinev: Route-level: the circle spans the escape route from St. Charles west to the capture farm, which the 1914 Webb Olmsted atlas places in sec. 18 T106N R11W (farmstead and grove about 43.9844,-92.1800, woodlot just east across the road) (about 5 km).

src: Webb, Atlas of Olmsted County, Minnesota (1914)
